$comment: Settings for SharePointGovernance/tools/build_solution.py --root solutions/PortalSnapshots. Bump 'version' for every release you import.
description: Refreshes the HPUK Asset Management, Project Management Control Board and IT Governance portal pages from SharePoint lists by writing their embedded snapshot on a schedule.

PortalSiteUrl.description: Site that holds the portal pages and their templates, e.g. https://{tenant}.sharepoint.com/sites/hpuk-it-portals. No trailing slash.

PortalPagesFolder.description: Server-relative folder on the portal site the flows write the pages to. /SitePages for SharePoint HTML pages (Allow HTML files must be on), or /SiteAssets to keep the existing SiteAssets links.

PortalTemplatesFolder.description: Server-relative folder holding the portal templates (pages with an empty snapshot block). Upload new portal versions here, never a saved snapshot.

PortalSnapshotsEnabled.description: Master switch for flows P1-P3. No (the default) means they read and write nothing. Set to Yes once the templates are uploaded and a manual run has been checked.

PortalOwnerEmail.description: Shared mailbox that gets the Flow failed alerts and the not-published emails (template not ready, page too large). Never a person's own address.

PortalSupportMailboxEmail.description: Optional second address copied on every failure email. Empty means no copy.

PortalAssetSiteUrl.description: Site holding the Asset Register and Asset Requests lists (flow P1).

PortalBoardSiteUrl.description: Site holding Programme Status, Board Decisions, Programme RAID, Migration Waves and Programme Gates (flow P2).

PortalGovernanceSiteUrl.description: The IT Enterprise Governance site: the SharePointGovernance solution's Site Register and Decision Log, plus the Compliance Register, Governance Risks, Policy Exceptions, Governance Actions and Automation Run Log (flow P3).
